findings.summary: Spec §0.3 (inherited gap, item 3) mandates a discriminative test that drives production spawnExport with a sourceMessageId absent from the doc channel and asserts loud failure without falling back to the system clock (⛔ not a source-string match). Production throws at tick-run.ts:1396-1401, but no test exercises this path — the only spawnExport throw-test asserts MissingExportRootError (g4c-generate-wiring.test.ts:526) and the positive path uses a found message. A regression that silently falls back to new Date() or returns a falsy createdAt would not be caught.
